info.description:
Run the folders in order (Runner works too). Start the backend first: .\mvnw.cmd spring-boot:run
The API uses a session cookie and CSRF protection, exactly like the web app. Postman keeps the cookie for you; the first request of each folder stores the CSRF token.

request.description: Run this first, and again after signing out. It stores the XSRF-TOKEN cookie in {{xsrf}}; every POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE sends it back in the X-XSRF-TOKEN header.
